title: GTA 6's $2,500 Dirt Bike Race Is Impossible to Fail 🏍️ #Shorts
description:
In GTA 6, the Thrillbillies dirt bike race at the Thrillbilly Mud Club pays $2,500 for first place, and the cash goes toward Jason and Lucia's $15,000 goal to move to Vice City. You race over a dozen riders, the AI is reckless, one crash can end your race... but you can't fail: lower places just earn less.

Source: Video Games Chronicle (VGC), "GTA 6 Thrillbillies walkthrough" (Nov 21, 2026).
Images: official Rockstar Games trailers (An Extended Look, Trailer 2).

Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
